title: skins restyle the UI and stay readable

clauses.text: Paper, Glass night, Blueprint and Calm each change the colours and the look, and the text stays readable

steps.do: Open Settings, Appearance and choose each skin in turn: Paper, Glass night, Blueprint, Calm. Look at the launcher and the Settings page after each one.
steps.expect: Each skin changes the colours and the launcher; the text stays readable on each skin.

steps.do: Choose a skin and open an SDK app that sets its own accent colour.
steps.expect: The app's accent colour is kept when it reads well on the skin; otherwise it is moved towards the skin's own colour.
